overview_description.description:
NiYO is a fintech that uses technology to simplify finance and hence make banking easier. NiYO helps salaried employees access company benefits and other financial services.

Founded in 2015, NiYO partners with companies (employers) and banks to offer employees the opportunity to access their benefits, such as healthcare or food allowances, through a digital platform. That includes a mobile app for submitting claims, and the option of a credit card.

about_short_description.short_description: NiYO is a FinTech company that helps employees access company benefits and other financial services.

product.name: Niyo Zero Forex Card
product.description: International payment cards that let Indian customers load funds in INR and spend abroad in multiple currencies without an added forex markup on eligible transactions.

product.name: Niyo International Debit Card
product.description: A Visa debit card linked to a Niyo partner-bank savings account that supports international payments and ATM withdrawals with zero forex markup on eligible transactions.

product.name: Niyo FD-Backed Credit Card
product.description: A secured credit card issued against a fixed deposit or lien-marked balance, offering international spending, credit-building functionality, and zero forex markup on eligible transactions.

product.name: Niyo International Money Transfer
product.description: A digital outward-remittance service for sending money from India to overseas bank accounts for education, family support, travel, medical, visa, and related permitted expenses.

product.name: Niyo Currency Exchange
product.description: An online foreign-currency ordering service that lets customers buy physical foreign notes at live exchange rates, receive them at home, and sell unused currency back.

product.name: Niyo Travel Services
product.description: A digital travel marketplace for booking flights, hotels, visas, travel insurance, international eSIMs, and tours or attractions through the Niyo platform.
